note: SK1: migrated to the Dubhe 1.2.x dappHub/UserStorage model (session keys). The 1.1.x deployment under `superseded_1_1_x` is SUPERSEDED — the new storage model needs a FRESH publish (new packageId + DappStorage; per-miner UserStorage), not an upgrade. Public ids only; NO secrets. Deployer/admin = the `mir2-onchain-mine` testnet wallet (key in the local Sui keystore).

toolchain.note: Move.toml Sui dep MUST stay override=true at testnet-v1.73.0 (generated default mainnet-v1.46.3 conflicts with the framework's Sui); re-apply after every `dubhe generate`.

deployment.deployedVia: sui client publish (keystore) + genesis::run(dappHub, clock) + admin_system::set_mine — links the canonical testnet Dubhe framework, no key export needed (dubhe publish would have required PRIVATE_KEY in .env).
deployment.note: frameworkPackageId + dappHubId = the canonical SHARED testnet Dubhe framework objects. UserStorage is per-miner — each miner calls user_storage_init::init_user_storage once (the web does this automatically on first batch / session activation). Web env: NEXT_PUBLIC_ONCHAIN_MINE_{PACKAGE_ID,FRAMEWORK_PACKAGE_ID,DAPP_HUB_ID,DAPP_STORAGE_ID} (apps/web/.env.local locally; Vercel project env for the hosted site). No indexer URL needed — the relayer reads events directly from the Sui fullnode.

1.note: smoke mine — hit/drop 100/100 makes the roll deterministic; real rates (Crystal ~25/10) are admin-settable via admin_system::set_mine

superseded_1_1_x.note: M1 (1.1.x flat-Schema) deployment — superseded by SK1; not session-key capable. Kept for reference.
